_readme: Assumptions, reference prices and sources for the tools. Every figure shown to users comes from here or from the documented calc modules. Each reference value carries its source and the date it was checked. Update the date when you re-verify.

loadedMultiplierNotes.GBP: UK: employer National Insurance is 15% above the secondary threshold (2025/26 and 2026/27) and the auto-enrolment minimum employer pension contribution is 3%. 1.2 is a simplified, rounded estimate that ignores thresholds and other benefits.
loadedMultiplierNotes.USD: US: wages and salaries were 70.0% of private-industry employer compensation costs in June 2026 (BLS ECEC), i.e. a multiplier of about 1.43. Rounded down to 1.4.
loadedMultiplierNotes.EUR: Employer on-costs vary widely across eurozone countries. 1.3 is a judgement; replace it with your own figure.

platforms.label: Microsoft Teams
platforms.note: No reference price shown: Microsoft list prices could not be verified when this tool was published, and Teams is usually licensed inside a Microsoft 365 bundle. Enter your own per-user monthly cost.

reference.plan: Zoom Workplace Pro, per user per month, billed annually
Google Workspace Business Starter, per user per month, annual commitment, excl. tax (UK)

platforms.label: Cisco Webex
platforms.note: Webex does not publish a paid per-user price (free tier or contact sales). Enter your own figure.

rooms._note: Illustrative planning figures for installed meeting-room technology (display, camera/audio, control, installation). They are NOT quotes or market data. Replace with your own costs.
